title: Ball Enhancer
description: Cobblemon addon adding enhanced Poké Balls with configurable catch-rate bonuses, penalty variants, refunds, and Cobblemon-style 2D/3D rendering.
body:
# Ball Enhancer

**Ball Enhancer** is a Cobblemon addon that adds enhanced versions of several Poké Balls with configurable catch-rate bonuses and penalty variants.

The mod adds `++` and `--` versions of Poké Ball, Great Ball, Ultra Ball and Premier Ball.  
`++` Balls provide a stable catch-rate bonus and consume 1 ball.  
`--` Balls provide a stronger catch-rate bonus, consume 3 balls when thrown, and refund 1 ball after a successful capture.

Ball Enhancer is designed to stay close to the Cobblemon visual style, with clean 2D inventory icons and 3D Cobblemon-style models in hand and on the ground.

## Features

- Adds enhanced Poké Ball variants:
  - Poké Ball++
  - Poké Ball--
  - Great Ball++
  - Great Ball--
  - Ultra Ball++
  - Ultra Ball--
  - Premier Ball++
  - Premier Ball--
- Configurable catch-rate multipliers
- Penalty Ball system:
  - consumes 3 balls on throw
  - refunds 1 ball after a successful capture
  - configurable refund delay
- Cobblemon-style rendering:
  - 2D icons in inventory and hotbar
  - 3D ball models in hand and on the ground
- Simple tooltip showing catch rate
- `/be info` command to explain the mechanics
- `/be reload` command to reload the config
- English and French translations

## Commands

- `/be info` — Shows how Ball Enhancer works.
- `/be reload` — Reloads the config. Requires operator permission.

## Notes

Penalty Balls only throw one visible ball, but they consume 3 items total.  
If the capture succeeds, 1 ball is refunded after the configured delay.
